'''''Heteranthera''''' is a genus of [[aquatic plant]]s in the [[water hyacinth]] family, [[Pontederiaceae]], known generally as '''mud plantains'''. Species of this genus are native to tropical and subtropical [[Americas|America]] and [[Africa]]. They live in the water or in wet soils. They produce leaves on long [[Petiole (botany)|petioles]] and some are cultivated for their attractive flowers. Leaves are of two types - linear and submerged or orbicular and floating. Some species have [[Cleistogamy|cleistogamic]] flowers.
